# Lele Liao

I build dashboards, analytical models, and business-facing stories that help teams understand performance, prioritize action, and communicate insight clearly.

This site combines the structure of my original single-page portfolio with the depth of my Quarto coursework site. The result is a clearer experience: who I am, what I have worked on, and how my projects connect to practical analytics work.
